燕青打擂
水浒
之廿三
出版说明
《水浒》是我国的一部古典文学名著。为了满足广大读者的需要，我们把它编绘成连环画册。在编绘上尽量保持原著故事情节，但是为了适合用连环画来表现，个别情节也作了一些删节和改动。
全部画册分为三十集，每集内容各有比较完整的故事，可以独自成章；同时各集内容上下衔接，以便连续阅读。为了阅读方便，每集开头写有内容提要，结尾附有后记，用以交代上集、本集和下集故事大意。
《水浒》连环画，我社1956——1962年出版过。现在这套连环画，是用原有的文学脚本重新绘制的。
page_text_en:
Yan Qing Fights in the Arena
Water Margin
No. 23
Publishing Note
"Water Margin" is a classical Chinese literary masterpiece. To meet the needs of a broad readership, we have adapted it into a series of illustrated storybooks. In the adaptation, we have tried to preserve the original plot as much as possible, but have made some deletions and modifications to suit the format of illustrated storytelling.
The entire series consists of thirty volumes, each containing a relatively complete story that can stand alone; at the same time, the volumes are connected to allow for continuous reading. For convenience, each volume begins with a content summary and ends with a postscript that outlines the plot of the previous, current, and next volumes.
The "Water Margin" illustrated series was previously published by our publishing house between 1956 and 1962. This current set of illustrated stories has been newly drawn using the original literary script.

内容提要
上集《李逵闹东京》写的是：梁山泊重阳菊花会，
宋江赋诗望朝廷招安，武松、鲁智深、李逵反对招安受
责。宋江到东京观灯，李逵、燕青等随行。宋江两次到
李师师家，欲通过李师师门路求皇上招安。李逵怒打杨
太尉，火烧李师师家，大闹东京。李逵、燕青回山寨
路过荆门镇，听说刘太公的女儿被宋江劫去，李逵大
怒，上山要与宋江决裂。宋江与李逵同到荆门镇对证。
李逵负荆请罪，捉假宋江，救出刘太公女儿。
本集写燕青到泰安打擂台，李逵私自下山与燕青
同行。燕青智胜任原。任原门徒争抢利物，惹起李逵
不平，大闹泰安州。梁山英雄摆宴为燕青庆贺胜利。
1 话说三月的一天，风和日暖，燕青在山下拦住一批
客商。客商们说是到泰安州去烧香，同时看有名的摔跤
家任原摆擂台的。燕青就放他们走了。
page_text_en:
Content Summary
The previous volume, "Li Kui Causes Trouble in Dongjing," describes: The Chongyang Chrysanthemum Festival at Liangshan Marsh, where Song Jiang writes poetry hoping for imperial recruitment, while Wu Song, Lu Zhishen, and Li Kui oppose it and are reprimanded. Song Jiang goes to Dongjing to watch the lanterns, accompanied by Li Kui, Yan Qing, and others. Song Jiang visits Li Shishi's house twice, hoping to gain imperial recruitment through her connections. Li Kui beats Yang Taizhui, burns Li Shishi's house, and causes chaos in Dongjing. Li Kui and Yan Qing return to the mountain camp, passing through Jingmen Town, where they hear that Liu Taigong's daughter has been abducted by Song Jiang. Li Kui becomes furious and goes up the mountain to confront Song Jiang. Song Jiang and Li Kui go together to Jingmen Town to verify the truth. Li Kui carries a thorn branch to apologize, captures the fake Song Jiang, and rescues Liu Taigong's daughter.
This volume describes Yan Qing going to Taian to fight in the martial arts tournament, with Li Kui secretly descending the mountain to accompany Yan Qing. Yan Qing outwits Ren Yuan. Ren Yuan's disciples fight over spoils, provoking Li Kui's anger, leading to chaos in Taian Prefecture. The heroes of Liangshan hold a banquet to celebrate Yan Qing's victory.
1. One day in March, with pleasant weather, Yan Qing stops a group of merchants at the foot of the mountain. The merchants say they are going to Taian Prefecture to burn incense and watch the famous wrestler Ren Yuan's martial arts tournament. Yan Qing lets them go.
summary_zh: 本页为《水浒》连环画第廿三集《燕青打擂》的内容提要，回顾了上集《李逵闹东京》的主要情节，并介绍了本集故事梗概：燕青赴泰安打擂，李逵同行，最终燕青战胜任原，梁山英雄庆贺胜利。页面下方是故事第一格，描绘燕青在山下放行前往泰安州烧香看擂台的客商。

2 燕青最爱摔跤。他从香客口中，得知任原自称擎天柱，每逢天齐神诞，就在泰安州东岳庙摆擂台，两年没有一个对手。燕青很想去和任原比比武，便兴冲冲地上山禀明宋江。
3 宋江听说任原十分勇猛，怕燕青不是对手，便劝他不要前去。
page_text_en:
2 Yan Qing loved wrestling. From the words of pilgrims, he learned that Ren Yuan called himself 'Qingtian Zhu' (Pillar of the Sky), and every time the God of Heaven's birthday came, he would set up a wrestling platform at the Dongyue Temple in Taian Prefecture, having defeated every challenger for two years. Yan Qing was eager to challenge Ren Yuan, so he excitedly went up the mountain to report to Song Jiang.
3 Song Jiang, hearing that Ren Yuan was extremely fierce, feared Yan Qing might not be his match, and thus advised him not to go.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了燕青得知泰安州东岳庙有擂台比武后，兴冲冲上山禀报宋江，宋江因担心燕青不敌对手任原而劝阻他不要前往的情节。

5 宋江不好再阻拦，吩咐置备酒宴送行。燕青扮成山东货郎的样子：挑一杂货担子，腰里还插着一把串鼓儿。众人不禁笑起来。
page_text_en:
Xiao Yi is very cautious.
I'll send someone to meet you then.
Nothing will go wrong.

4 Yan Qing said, 'I can use strength when needed, and if not, I can use wit. As long as I adapt to the situation, I won't lose.' Lu Junyi, who knew Yan Qing's skills well, persuaded Song Jiang to let him try.

5 Song Jiang could no longer stop him and ordered a banquet to see him off. Yan Qing dressed up as a Shandong peddler: carrying a杂货担子 (miscellaneous goods pole), with a string of small drums tucked in his waist. Everyone couldn't help but laugh.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了燕青决心赴泰安打擂，卢俊义劝说宋江同意后，宋江设宴送行，燕青扮成货郎模样，众人见状发笑的情景。

6 燕青辞别众弟兄下山，往泰安州走去。傍晚他正要寻店安歇，忽听后头有人喊叫。他回头一看，却是黑旋风李逵。
这事用你不着，你快回去。
上两次你帮我，这一回我帮你，去定了！
7 燕青问李逵来做什么，李逵说，他是私自下山给小乙哥帮忙的。燕青要他回去，李逵哪里肯听。
page_text_en:
Little Brother, wait for me a moment.
6 Yan Qing bid farewell to his brothers and went down the mountain towards Taian Prefecture. In the evening, as he was about to find an inn to rest, he suddenly heard someone calling from behind. He turned around and saw it was Black Whirlwind Li Kui.
You don't need to be involved in this, go back quickly.
The last two times you helped me, this time I'll help you, I'm going for sure!
7 Yan Qing asked Li Kui what he was doing there. Li Kui said he had secretly come down the mountain to help Little Brother. Yan Qing told him to go back, but Li Kui wouldn't listen.
summary_zh: 燕青下山前往泰安州，傍晚时分被李逵追上。李逵执意要跟随燕青去打擂，燕青劝他回去，但李逵不听，坚持要帮忙。

page_text_en:
Which three things? I can't be made to pretend to be mute again!
8 Yan Qing was very troubled. If he didn't let him go, it would hurt their brotherhood; if he did let him go, he feared someone at the temple fair might recognize him, causing trouble. After thinking, Yan Qing proposed that Li Kui must obey three conditions.
These three things,
Brother, will you agree?
This is acceptable,
Let's do it!
9 Yan Qing said: First, walk separately on the road; second, after staying at an inn, Li Kui must pretend to be sick and sleep with his head covered, not leaving the room without permission; third, when watching the wrestling match, don't make a big fuss.
summary_zh: 燕青为带李逵同行赴泰安打擂而烦恼，担心李逵惹事，于是提出三条规矩，李逵虽不情愿但最终答应遵守。

12 After Yan Qing finished looking, he raised his shoulder pole and smashed the pink sign, indicating that he wanted to wrestle with Ren Yuan. Some onlookers, eager to get involved, hurried off to deliver the message to Ren Yuan.
13 The Dongyue Temple was holding its incense festival, with many tourists around. The inns along the street were all full. Yan Qing found Li Kui on the street, and the two of them searched for a while before finally finding an inn.

17 The innkeeper first said he didn't know. When others told him the challenger was a peddler, he realized the two guests he had just served were the wrestlers. He then pointed out the room where Yan Qing and Li Kui were staying. The door was tightly shut, so the crowd could only peek through the window. They saw two people sleeping on the bed, with no other signs of activity.

summary_zh: 卢俊义带领七位好汉和一千多军士前来接应，燕青和李逵从屋顶跳下与梁山人马会合，李逵取出双斧加入战斗。

52 等到官府集合官兵来时，梁山人马早已去远了。官兵害怕梁山势众，不敢追赶。
53 卢俊义带领人马回山，走了半日，一路上又不见了李逵。卢俊义怕李逵惹祸，穆弘情愿自己留下去寻找。
page_text_en:
52 When the government gathered its troops, the Liangshan forces had already gone far away. The soldiers, fearing the large number of Liangshan troops, dared not pursue.
53 Lu Junyi led his troops back to the mountain. After half a day, they no longer saw Li Kui. Worried that Li Kui might cause trouble, Lu Junyi agreed to let Mu Hong stay behind to search for him.
summary_zh: 官府集结官兵时，梁山人马已远去，官兵不敢追赶；卢俊义率队回山途中发现李逵不见，穆弘自愿留下寻找。

title_zh: 连环画《水浒传23：燕青打擂》张仁康 王重圭 绘

page_text_ocr_zh:
54 原来李逵横冲直撞，竟来到了寿张县。
55 当时午衙才散。李逵来到县衙门前大喊，吓得衙役们动弹不得。
我的天呀！
梁山泊黑旋风爷爷在此！
page_text_en:
54 Originally, Li Kui charged recklessly and ended up in Shouzhang County.
55 It was just after the noon court session. Li Kui arrived at the county衙 gate and shouted, frightening the guards so they couldn't move.
My goodness!
Here is Li Kui, the Black Whirlwind of Liangshan!
summary_zh: 李逵横冲直撞来到寿张县，午衙刚散时在县衙门前大喊，吓住了衙役们。

title_zh: 连环画《水浒传23：燕青打擂》张仁康 王重圭 绘
title_en: Classic Illustrated Stories: Water Margin 23 - Yan Qing's Wrestling Match

page_text_ocr_zh:
叫出知县来，我有话讲。
知县相公已
从后门跑了。
56 李逵闯进衙内，在大堂中知县的椅子上坐下，喊人
来回话。
57 李逵不信，自己到后堂来寻，寻不着，却见纱帽、
官袍、朝靴都在架上放着。
page_text_en:
Call out the magistrate, I have something to say.
The magistrate has already fled through the back door.
56 Li Kui burst into the衙 (yé, official residence), sat on the magistrate's chair in the main hall, and called for someone to answer him.
57 Li Kui didn't believe it, so he went to the back hall himself to look. He couldn't find him, but saw the official hat, robe, and court shoes placed on a rack.
summary_zh: 李逵闯入县衙，坐在知县的椅子上喊人回话，得知知县已从后门逃跑，便亲自到后堂寻找，只见其官帽、官袍和朝靴仍在架上。

title_zh: 连环画《水浒传23：燕青打擂》张仁康 王重圭 绘
title_en: Classic Illustrated Stories: Water Margin 23 - Yan Qing's Wrestling Match

58 李逵一时高兴，便把知县的衣帽穿戴戴上；脱了麻鞋，换上朝靴，手拿官简，走到大堂，大声喊道：‘官差人等，都来参见！’
59 差役等不敢不依，上前行礼。李逵又摆出升堂的架势，要差役们擂鼓唱喏。
page_text_en:
58 Li Kui, overjoyed, put on the magistrate's robes and hat; took off his hemp shoes, put on official boots, held the official tablet, walked to the main hall, and shouted loudly: 'Officials and runners, come and pay your respects!'
59 The runners dared not disobey, and approached to bow. Li Kui then struck a pose as if presiding over a court session, ordering the runners to beat the drum and shout the formal greeting.
summary_zh: 李逵穿上知县的官服，在大堂上自封为官，命令差役们参见并擂鼓唱喏，模仿升堂审案的场面。

title_zh: 连环画《水浒传23：燕青打擂》张仁康 王重圭 绘
title_en: Classic Illustrated Stories: Water Margin 23 - Yan Qing's Wrestling Match

60 差役们不敢不依。李逵见了，哈哈大笑，吩咐放牌受状。恰巧有两个人在衙前拥挤打架，李逵叫抓进来审问。
61 李逵问起情由。原告说被告先动手，被告说原告先骂人。李逵命令被告回骂一句，原告回打一拳，就算两下拉平。
page_text_en:
60 The constables dared not disobey. Li Kui, seeing this, laughed heartily and ordered the gates opened to receive complaints. Coincidentally, two men were fighting and pushing each other in front of the yamen; Li Kui had them seized and brought in for questioning.
61 Li Kui asked about the circumstances. The plaintiff said the defendant had started the fight first, while the defendant claimed the plaintiff had insulted him first. Li Kui ordered the defendant to insult the plaintiff once, and the plaintiff to hit him once, and declared that would settle the matter as even.
summary_zh: 李逵穿上知县官服后，命令差役放牌受状，将两名在衙前打架的百姓抓来审问，并以荒唐方式判决：让被告回骂一句，原告回打一拳，便算两下拉平。

62 李逵审毕，仍旧县官打扮，大踏步走出县衙。衙前百姓见了，都笑了起来。
63 李逵在街上东张西望，忽听一处私塾里传出读书声音。他揭起帘子走进去，吓得先生跳窗而逃。学生们也跑的跑，藏的藏。
page_text_en:
62 After Li Kui finished his trial, he still dressed as a county magistrate, and strode out of the county office. The common people in front of the office saw him and all started laughing.
63 Li Kui was looking around on the street when he suddenly heard the sound of reading from a private school. He lifted the curtain and walked in, scaring the teacher into jumping out the window to escape. The students also ran away or hid.
summary_zh: 李逵审案结束后仍穿着县官服饰走出衙门，百姓见状大笑；随后他在街上听到私塾读书声，闯入后吓跑先生，学生们纷纷逃跑或躲藏。

64 李逵一笑走出，正好遇上穆弘。穆弘说大家等他等得好生着急，一把拖住他就走。
65 二人回到梁山泊，走进忠义堂。堂上正摆下酒宴，为燕青贺喜。众好汉看见李逵这样打扮，不禁哄堂大笑。李逵摇摇摆摆来拜宋江，才拜了两拜，便被官袍绊倒。
page_text_en:
64 Li Kui smiled and walked out, just meeting Mu Hong. Mu Hong said everyone had been waiting for him anxiously, and grabbed him to go.
65 The two returned to Liangshan Marsh and entered the Hall of Loyalty and Righteousness. A banquet was set up in the hall to celebrate Yan Qing's success. The heroes saw Li Kui dressed like this and burst into laughter. Li Kui waddled forward to bow to Song Jiang, but after only two bows, he tripped over his official robe.
summary_zh: 李逵在寿张县穿上知县官服后，被穆弘找到并带回梁山泊。他身穿官服进入忠义堂，众人见状大笑，李逵在向宋江行礼时被官袍绊倒。

66 宋江斥责李逵不守纪律，私自下山，还到处惹祸；责令他必须向众兄弟认错谢罪。宋江还告诫李逵，以后不准再犯。
67 燕青给李逵讲情，李逵连连谢罪，说下次不敢。大家一齐入座，举杯为燕青贺喜。
page_text_en:
66 Song Jiang scolded Li Kui for breaking discipline, going down the mountain without permission, and causing trouble everywhere; he ordered Li Kui to apologize to all the brothers. Song Jiang also warned Li Kui not to do it again.
67 Yan Qing pleaded for Li Kui, and Li Kui repeatedly apologized, saying he wouldn't dare do it again. Everyone sat down together and raised their cups to celebrate Yan Qing's success.
summary_zh: 李逵因私自下山惹祸被宋江斥责，需向众兄弟认错；燕青为其讲情后，李逵认错，众人举杯为燕青贺喜。

后记
下集《黑旋风扯诏》说的是：朝廷派太尉陈宗善去梁山招安。宋江安排接诏；吴用、林冲等不甘心招安。吴用暗与三阮、李逵设计。阮小七放水漏船，偷换御酒，戏弄差官；忠义堂开读诏书，书中许多辱骂恐吓梁山的词句，众好汉被激怒；李逵撕毁诏书，怒打差官；众好汉大闹忠义堂。招安未成，陈太尉狼狈回京。

Postscript
The next volume, 'Black Whirlwind Tears the Edict,' tells of: The court sends Grand Marshal Chen Zongshan to Liangshan to recruit them. Song Jiang arranges to receive the edict; Wu Yong, Lin Chong, and others are unwilling to accept recruitment. Wu Yong secretly conspires with the Three Yuans and Li Kui. Yuan Xiaqi lets water leak into the boat, swaps the imperial wine, and mocks the imperial envoys; at the Hall of Loyalty and Righteousness, the edict is read aloud, containing many insulting and threatening phrases toward Liangshan, which infuriates the heroes; Li Kui tears up the edict and beats the envoys; the heroes cause a commotion in the Hall of Loyalty and Righteousness. The recruitment fails, and Grand Marshal Chen returns to the capital in disgrace.
